title: Law to require traffic calming devices in 50 bike lane intersections
summary: This bill would require the Department of Transportation to install traffic calming devices, such as bike lane redesigns, chicanes or raised crosswalks, at no less than 50 street intersections with bicycle lanes within one year of the law taking effect. The department must study the safety impact of these installations and report its findings, including crash and injury data, to the mayor and Council within about two and a half years. The commissioner may skip an installation if it would endanger motorists, pedestrians or cyclists.
